en: Self-hosted runner: Changed git in lifecycle hooks to ignore hook folders and programs named in the runner's shared git files; local-path and `git://` remotes there now need `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL`
zh: 自托管运行器：生命周期 hook 中的 git 现在会忽略运行器共享 git 文件中指定的 hook 文件夹和程序；其中的本地路径和 `git://` 远程现在需要 `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL`
